output.pixel_handling: Byte-preserving copy of native generated PNG

visual_review.method: Visual inspection of the generated image, focusing on composition, object structure, lighting and material details.

core_checks.observed: 原生 PNG 为 1672×941，目标 16:9；长边相对 16/9 比例的整数像素取整差为 0.888889 像素。
core_checks.requirement: 横竖方向符合请求，保留实际原生像素并记录与目标比例的取整差。

core_checks.observed: 椭圆凹勺碗、连续细边、收窄勺颈与圆端长柄完整连贯，金属明暗反射表现凹面。
core_checks.requirement: 现实咖啡勺具有可辨识的功能部件、连贯结构和可信表面。

core_checks.observed: 右手以拇指、食指和中指控制木质铅笔，笔尖触及勺碗轮廓；另一只手稳住图纸，旁边完整实物提供对应。
core_checks.requirement: 手部支撑、握笔与接触关系真实，图稿对应同一勺形。

core_checks.observed: 两张图纸在主体右侧交叠，下层截面研究透出；完整勺与研究图共同置于连续桌面，手腕在操作位置进入。
core_checks.requirement: 两层纸、完整主体与必要手部接触共同构成一次清楚的描绘动作。

additional_checks.observed: The image supports a judgment about visible construction and material appearance. Physical manufacturing measurements and material composition were not supplied.
The tool returned its native raster size. Requested numerical rendering dimensions are design intent; the output section records the actual delivered pixels.
